canonical:
glassbox-canonical 1
version 2
id "car-radio"
title "Car radio"
clock seconds
initial "off"
notes 16
  note "The acceptance test for phase 1 of docs/kb/plans/the-same-machine.md:"
  note "a machine that exists ONLY as this file. No PureScript was written for it,"
  note "no constructor names it, nothing was recompiled to add it. If that ever"
  note "stops being true, the thesis has failed."
  note ""
  note "It also exercises the three things a general FSM format tends to lack:"
  note "config that RESHAPES the machine (turn off the CD slot and the cd state"
  note "becomes unreachable, and the diagram changes to say so), a state that"
  note "resolves by itself (seeking gives up after a while with no user event),"
  note "and refusals that carry a reason rather than doing nothing silently."
  note ""
  note "Since the effects fork it also carries commands. Note that every source"
  note "state establishes itself on ENTRY — tune the radio, spin the disc up — so"
  note "the host is told what must now be true rather than what changed. Only two"
  note "exits exist, and both tear down something no other state can own: the seek"
  note "scanner and the phone connection."
states 5
  state "bluetooth" "Bluetooth" false (entry 1 "connect-phone") (exit 1 "disconnect-phone")
  state "cd" "CD" false (entry 1 "spin-up-disc") (exit 0)
  state "off" "Off" false (entry 1 "power-down") (exit 0)
  state "radio" "Radio" false (entry 1 "tune-radio") (exit 0)
  state "seeking" "Seeking" false (entry 1 "start-seek") (exit 1 "stop-seek")
events 6
  event "cancel" "cancel" user
  event "eject" "eject" user
  event "giveup" "no station found" runtime
  event "power" "power" user
  event "seek" "seek" user
  event "source" "source" user
config 2
  config "has-cd-slot" "This trim has a CD slot" (bool true)
  config "seek-seconds" "Seek gives up after (s)" (num 8)
facts 2
  fact "bluetooth-paired" "A phone is paired"
  fact "disc-loaded" "A disc is in the slot"
refusals 3
  refusal "no-disc" "there is no disc in the slot"
  refusal "no-phone" "no phone is paired"
  refusal "not-fitted" "this car has no CD slot"
commands 7
  command "connect-phone" "Connect the paired phone"
  command "disconnect-phone" "Disconnect the phone"
  command "power-down" "Shut the head unit down"
  command "spin-up-disc" "Spin the disc up and play it"
  command "start-seek" "Start scanning for a station"
  command "stop-seek" "Stop scanning"
  command "tune-radio" "Tune to the stored station"
rules 30
  rule "bluetooth" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "bluetooth" "eject" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "no-disc")))
  rule "bluetooth" "giveup" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "bluetooth" "power" (cases 1 (case - (move "off")))
  rule "bluetooth" "seek" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "bluetooth" "source" (cases 1 (case - (move "radio")))
  rule "cd" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "cd" "eject" (cases 1 (case - (move "radio")))
  rule "cd" "giveup" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "cd" "power" (cases 1 (case - (move "off")))
  rule "cd" "seek" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "cd" "source" (cases 2 (case (holds (fact "bluetooth-paired")) (move "bluetooth")) (case - (refuse "no-phone")))
  rule "off" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "off" "eject" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "off" "giveup" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "off" "power" (cases 1 (case - (move "radio")))
  rule "off" "seek" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "off" "source" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "radio" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "radio" "eject" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "no-disc")))
  rule "radio" "giveup" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "radio" "power" (cases 1 (case - (move "off")))
  rule "radio" "seek" (cases 1 (case - (move "seeking")))
  rule "radio" "source" (cases 4 (case (and 2 (holds (config "has-cd-slot")) (holds (fact "disc-loaded"))) (move "cd")) (case (not (holds (config "has-cd-slot"))) (refuse "not-fitted")) (case (not (holds (fact "disc-loaded"))) (refuse "no-disc")) (case - (stay)))
  rule "seeking" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (move "radio")))
  rule "seeking" "eject" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "no-disc")))
  rule "seeking" "giveup" (cases 1 (case - (move "radio")))
  rule "seeking" "power" (cases 1 (case - (move "off")))
  rule "seeking" "seek" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "seeking" "source" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
deadlines 1
  deadline "seeking" "giveup" (config "seek-seconds")
